title: **TEHRAN - September 21—** Videos showing two unidentified luminous objects over several Iranian cities, including Tehran, circulated on social media late Sunday (Sep20), with many users speculating they were alien spacecraft.
text:
**TEHRAN - September 21—** Videos showing two unidentified luminous objects over several Iranian cities, including Tehran, circulated on social media late Sunday (Sep20), with many users speculating they were alien spacecraft."

"Initial reports stressed the videos were unverified, and the objects’ identity, altitude, and exact location were unknown. No Iranian military or aviation authority issued an official explanation.
